mechanism: Magnesium acts as a natural calcium antagonist and may potentiate the bronchodilatory and systemic effects of albuterol beta-2 agonists, while albuterol may increase urinary magnesium losses.
action: Monitor for enhanced beta-2 agonist effects (tremor, tachycardia, hypokalemia); magnesium supplementation may be beneficial in asthma/COPD but requires coordinated dosing and electrolyte monitoring.
